text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day. Following up on when I 
accompanied her to the hospital, Mejiro 
Ardan came to consult with me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
To repay Baaya, I tried considering a few 
ideas in my own way. For instance—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
A 'Bargain Hunting Tour through Sale 
Flyers', or 'Reading Aloud the Complete 
History of the World', and such, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
...As expected, those hardly qualify as 
the best ideas, do they?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
Ah, if only there were a wonderful plan 
that could bring her instant joy—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
If ya wanna get hyped in a flash, dancin' 
at the club is the one and only way, yo~♪

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
For real, if ya vibe with the beat, 
errbody's happy! So like, let's go 
dancin'☆!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text: Eh?! H-Helios-san—?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Yaaay☆! Let's get hype! Weeeey!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
How's that, paisen?! Poppin' groove, 
right♪ Pep in your step in two seconds 
flat, right?☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
Thank you ever so much for your 
thoughtfulness. However, you see... The 
matter we were fretting over was—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I gotcha, I gotcha! All good♪ Basically, 
if we get granny feeling all hyuuupped up☆ 
then we totally win, right?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Then YO-U! You just gotta do some 
everybody dancin'♪ instead, senpai! Total 
EZ victory, right?☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text: ...... Um, pardon me for asking, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
Could it be that you are saying... there 
is a chance of success if I am the one to 
dance?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Yep☆ Look, look, watchin' other peeps 
dancin'♪ gets your hype meter through the 
roof, right?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Like when clips pop up on UmaSta, and you 
vibe to it in a split sec? Ya know? That's 
what we gotta go for, yeah♪
choice_data_list:
Showing her your energetic self might 
actually be a great idea.

Showing her your energetic self might 
actually be a great idea.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
I see... But would that work? Isn't the 
'hype' you speak of, Helios-san, something 
evoked by a skillful dance?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
I must embarrassingly admit that I don't 
have much experience dancing in such 
settings... So as for whether it would get 
her 'hyped'...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
No need for big brain thinking! It's all 
about riding the vibe with this kinda 
stuff☆ C'mon, c'mon~, I'll bust a move 
with ya♪

text_block_list.name: Young Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Nanny! Let us dance together! Look, just 
like in that anime! I am the princess! 
Now, take my hand~!

text_block_list.name: Nanny
text_block_list.text:
To my embarrassment, I have no experience 
with this, Milady. It would bring me great 
joy if you would lead the way.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text: (Together...)

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Wha-what is it~? Didja remember somethin'? 
Share the goss with me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I was merely reminiscing about my 
childhood.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
A faintly glowing memory from those gloomy 
days spent confined to a sickbed...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
Nanny was someone who devoted herself to 
doing anything and everything just to 
bring me joy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
And now I am to repay her kindness. If 
that is so—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
Then this time, I must be the one to give 
it my absolute everything...!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ayyy!! Nice groove♪ Pump up the vibes, 
let's gooo!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text: Fufu, yay!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
I see... This is... delightfully 
entertaining.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
Oh, please look. I received a reply from 
Nanny.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
How is it, how is it? Max vibes for sure, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
"Seeing Milady dancing so radiantly makes 
this old nanny's heart dance with joy as 
well"... it says.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text: Ah... what a relief.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
YAAAAY!! Total energetic pump-up☆ Granny's 
totally got that party animal talent in 
her, don'tcha think?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
Party animal... Ah, a banquet aficionado, 
you mean. I see, that perspective had 
never occurred to me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
Nanny loves flashy things... Fufu... I 
have learned something quite valuable.
